declaration.preface:
First Quality Knits is committed to conducting its business with the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability. Ethical conduct is fundamental to our operations and guides every decision, action, and interaction across all levels of the organization.

This Ethical Conduct Policy reflects our commitment to upholding strong ethical values in all aspects of our business, whether in our relationships with employees, customers, suppliers, or the broader community. We strive to foster a culture of honesty, fairness, and mutual respect, while ensuring full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal codes of conduct.

The policy outlines clear expectations for all stakeholders to act responsibly, avoid conflicts of interest, protect company assets, and contribute to maintaining the reputation of First Quality Knits as a reliable, ethical, and socially responsible organization.
declaration.declaration: At First Quality Knits, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of ethical behavior, integrity, and compliance in all our business operations. All employees, management, and business partners are expected to avoid conflicts of interest, and must not engage in bribery, corruption, or fraudulent practices. Company resources must be used responsibly, and confidentiality must be maintained at all times. All actions should comply with applicable laws and internal policies. A safe, confidential, and retaliation-free channel is available for reporting unethical behavior, reinforcing our commitment to transparency, accountability, and an ethical workplace culture.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, management, contractors, and third-party partners of First Quality Knitts across below given operational locations. It governs ethical behavior in all business activities and interactions, ensuring consistent standards of integrity and accountability throughout the organization and among any individuals or entities acting on its behalf.

Integrity in Business Practices: Promote transparency, accountability, and adherence to ethical standards in all internal and external business activities.
Maintain a culture of ethical decision-making at all organizational levels and ensure consistency in applying ethical standards in all internal and external operations.

An employee discovers that a colleague is exaggerating product specifications to secure a client order. The employee must report the issue to the designated compliance officer. All business actions at First Quality Knits must be guided by honesty and integrity. Misrepresentation of any kind is strictly prohibited.
Prevention of Corruption: Maintain a zero-tolerance policy toward bribery, kickbacks, and undue influence, ensuring full compliance with anti-corruption laws.
Maintain a zero-tolerance policy for bribery and corruption and ensure strict compliance with anti-corruption laws and company policies.

A vendor offers a procurement team member expensive gifts in exchange for a favourable contract decision. The team member must decline the offer and immediately report it. Accepting such gifts violates First Quality Knits’ anti-corruption policy. Employees must maintain fairness and transparency in all business interactions.
Conflict of Interest Management: Require prompt disclosure of any personal or professional interests that could compromise objective decision-making.
Maintain a transparent work culture where employees are encouraged to avoid personal interests that may conflict with business decisions.
Implement clear procedures for identifying and addressing conflicts of interest in an impartial manner.

A department head is asked to approve a service provider owned by a close relative. The relationship must be disclosed, and the individual must recuse themselves from the decision-making process. Employees must avoid any actions that may lead to personal benefit at the company’s expense.
Fraud Prevention and Detection: Strengthen internal controls, conduct regular audits, and encourage whistleblower reporting to prevent and detect fraudulent activities.
Provide regular training to all employees on fraud awareness, prevention, and reporting mechanisms.
Strengthen internal controls and awareness through routine monitoring and risk assessments.

A finance staff member identifies a vendor billing the same invoice twice for payment. The discrepancy must be reported immediately for investigation. All employees at First Quality Knitts are responsible for identifying and reporting suspicious or irregular financial activities.
Anti-Money Laundering Measures: Conduct due diligence on financial transactions and third-party engagements to prevent money laundering and ensure financial integrity.

A customer proposes breaking up a large transaction into smaller parts to bypass reporting rules. This behavior must be treated as a red flag and reported as per First Quality Knitts’ AML procedures. Employees should remain alert to unusual financial activity and follow reporting protocols.
Upholding Fair Competition: Comply with applicable antitrust and competition laws, avoid unfair trade practices, and support a fair, ethical marketplace.
Ensure compliance with fair competition and antitrust laws and hence promote transparency and fairness in all market dealings.

A marketing executive receives confidential pricing information about a competitor's bid. The information must not be used or shared. First Quality Knitts strictly prohibits anti-competitive behavior and complies fully with fair trade and competition laws.
Responsible Information Handling: Protect sensitive company, employee, and client data through secure and ethical data management and communication practices.
Protect sensitive business, employee, and client data and hence promote responsible information security, storage, and access control.
Implement mandatory password and access reviews every six months for all critical systems.
Continuously monitor and improve data protection practices to safeguard sensitive information.

A team member forgets sensitive customer documents in a shared meeting space. The incident must be reported to IT and the compliance team immediately. Confidential information must always be handled securely and disposed of properly as per company policy.
Transparency in Recordkeeping: Maintain accurate, honest, and timely financial and operational records to uphold legal compliance and ethical accountability.
Enable full legal and operational traceability through systematic documentation.

A supervisor intentionally delays recording a major expense to improve quarterly financial results. All financial records must be accurate and timely. Deliberate misreporting violates First Quality Knitts’ recordkeeping policy and can have legal consequences.

policy.monitoring:
At First Quality Knits, ethical conduct is a living commitment, continually refined to reflect evolving regulations, industry expectations, and emerging risks. A culture of integrity is deeply rooted at every level of the organization, ensuring consistent transparency, accountability, and legal compliance.

Regular Training & Awareness: All employees participate in annual training sessions covering core ethical areas such as anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, fraud prevention, AML, and data security.

Risk Assessments & Audits: Routine internal assessments and independent audits are conducted to identify ethical risks, assess policy effectiveness, and implement corrective measures.

Industry Collaboration: Engagement in industry forums and regulatory initiatives helps align company practices with evolving ethical standards and global best practices.

Technology-Driven Monitoring: Digital systems are used for automated compliance monitoring, fraud detection, and secure reporting to strengthen governance and response mechanisms.

Open Feedback Culture: Employees and stakeholders are encouraged to share concerns and suggestions through accessible feedback channels, supporting a transparent and ethically sound workplace.

First Quality Knitts maintains a zero-tolerance stance on all forms of ethical misconduct, including corruption, conflicts of interest, fraud, money laundering, and data breaches. Any confirmed violations are met with strict and proportionate disciplinary measures to uphold ethical standards.

Employees, suppliers, and external stakeholders are encouraged to report suspected violations through a secure and confidential whistleblower system that guarantees anonymity and protection against retaliation.

All reported concerns are treated with the utmost confidentiality and addressed through prompt and thorough investigation.

Investigations are led by the Compliance Officer, with support from internal teams or external experts as needed.

Following any ethical breach, corrective actions such as policy updates, enhanced controls, or targeted training are implemented to prevent recurrence. Insights gained from incidents are integrated into risk assessments and policy reviews, contributing to stronger ethical governance and resilience.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Ethical Conduct Policy is reviewed annually to ensure it remains relevant, effective, and aligned with applicable legal and regulatory standards. The review process is led by the Compliance Officer, in coordination with the Internal Audit Team and Human Resources.

Revisions may be made in response to audit outcomes, regulatory updates, employee feedback, or changes in business operations. All updates are communicated clearly across the organization, and necessary training is provided to ensure understanding and continued compliance by all employees.
